verdict.rationale: Cactus's own docs say its smallest models run locally with "no data leaving the device," and local fine-tuning runs on your own hardware and data. That keeps local data out of vendor hands by design. However, the hosted platform has you upload data, and the engine can route hard queries to the cloud, with no documented policy on whether that data is used for training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or opt-out control, clarity on how uploaded and cloud-routed data is used, and independent corroboration.
